name: The name a worker credential writes under is nobody else's
summary: actor_names.collision is the one rule for a worker credential's actor namespace: its head, case folded, must not be a session actor or a name of that shape, an operator or verifier list name, the web service's namespace, a name that reads as another, or a name the tracker already holds as an author or assignee. endpoint.py::tracker_actors treats an answer that is not a whole tracker -- no rows, a cut line, a nonzero bd, words that are not rows, or a missing merge slot -- as a host fault, never an empty tracker; the service answers 503. The rule applies at issue (422, nothing kept) and at use. A credential is judged by the rows once, passing in earlier same-name lifetimes, and the outcome kept on it (actor_rows_checked or actor_rows_refused) by _settle_actor_rows, so later writes read no tracker; the owner's list reads the kept refused mark. Rows inside an earlier same-name, same-owner lifetime are not held against a renewal (own_intervals); a lifetime ends at the earlier of revocation and expiry, the clock allowance applying only at its start. A waiver needs allow_actor and an allow_actor_reason of at most 500 plain-text characters, kept as actor_waived.
